question: What claim about the class of yoginīs is made by grouping them as all innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians?
premises: A class is described as all innate.
The same class is described as all family-born.
The same class is described as all door-guardians.
inference: The yoginī class is presented under three comprehensive designations covering origin and function.
uncertainties: The verse does not state whether these are three classes or three aspects of one class.
plain_english: All innate, all family-born, all door-guardians.
